parameters.description_en:
The access control list (ACL) of the object when it is created in OSS.

Valid values:

- default: The object inherits the ACL of the bucket in which it is stored.
- private: The object is a private resource. Only the object owner and authorized users have read and access permissions on the object. Other users cannot access the object.
- public-read: The object is a public-read resource. Only the object owner and authorized users have read and access permissions on the object. Other users have only read permissions on the object. Exercise caution when you set this value.
- public-read-write: The object is a public-read-write resource. All users have read and access permissions on the object. Exercise caution when you set this value.

For more information about ACLs, see **[ACL](~~100676~~)**.
parameters.description_zh:
指定OSS创建Object时的访问权限。
取值：

- default（默认）：Object遵循所在存储空间的访问权限。
- private：Object是私有资源。只有Object的拥有者和授权用户有该Object的读写权限，其他用户没有权限操作该Object。
- public-read：Object是公共读资源。只有Object的拥有者和授权用户有该Object的读写权限，其他用户只有该Object的读权限。请谨慎使用该权限。
- public-read-write：Object是公共读写资源。所有用户都有该Object的读写权限。请谨慎使用该权限。

关于访问权限的更多信息，请参见**[读写权限ACL](~~100676~~)**。
parameters.help_en:
The access control list (ACL) of the object that OSS creates.

Valid values:

- default: The object inherits the ACL of the bucket in which the object is stored.
- private: The object is a private resource. Only the object owner and authorized users have read and access permissions on the object. Other users do not have permissions to perform operations on the object.
- public-read: The object is a public-read resource. Only the object owner and authorized users have read and access permissions on the object. Other users have only read permissions on the object. Exercise caution when you set the ACL to this value.
- public-read-write: The object is a public-read-write resource. All users have read and access permissions on the object. Exercise caution when you set the ACL to this value.

For more information about ACLs, see **https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100676.html**

parameters.name: x_oss_object_acl

parameters.description_en:
The storage class of the bucket. Valid values:

- Standard (default): Standard.
- IA: Infrequent Access.
- Archive: Archive.
- ColdArchive: Cold Archive.
- DeepColdArchive: Deep Cold Archive.
parameters.description_zh:
Bucket的存储类型。 取值范围如下：

- Standard（默认）：标准存储
- IA：低频访问
- Archive：归档存储
- ColdArchive：冷归档存储
- DeepColdArchive：深度冷归档存储
parameters.help_en:
The storage class of the object.
If you specify this parameter when you upload an object to a bucket of any storage class, the object is stored as the specified storage class. For example, if you specify **x-oss-storage-class** as Standard when you upload an object to an Infrequent Access (IA) bucket, the object is stored as Standard.

Valid values:
- Standard
- IA: Infrequent Access
- Archive

If the size of an object of the IA or Archive storage class is smaller than 64 KB, the object is billed for 64 KB. We recommend that you do not set the storage class of an object to IA or Archive when you call the PutSymlink operation.
For more information about storage classes, see **https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/51374.html**
parameters.help_zh:
指定Object的存储类型。
对于任意存储类型的Bucket，如果上传Object时指定此参数，则此次上传的Object将存储为指定的类型。例如在IA类型的Bucket中上传Object时，如果指定**x-oss-storage-class**为Standard，则该Object直接存储为Standard。

取值：
- Standard：标准存储
- IA：低频访问
- Archive：归档存储

IA与Archive类型的单个Object大小如果不足64 KB，则会按64 KB计量计费。建议在使用PutSymlink接口时不要将Object的存储类型指定为IA或Archive。
关于存储类型的更多信息，请参见**https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/51374.html**
parameters.name: x_oss_storage_class

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to overwrite an existing object with the same name when you call the PutSymlink operation.
  - If you do not specify **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** or set **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** to **false**, an existing object with the same name is overwritten.
  - If you set **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** to **true**, an existing object with the same name is not overwritten.

Setting the **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** request header decreases the QPS processing performance. If you need to use the **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** request header in a large number of operations (QPS > 1,000), contact technical support to avoid impacts on your business.
> If versioning is enabled or suspended for the destination bucket, the **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** request header does not take effect. In this case, an existing object with the same name is overwritten.
parameters.description_zh:
指定PutSymlink操作时是否覆盖同名Object。
  - 不指定**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**或者指定**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**为**false**时，表示允许覆盖同名Object。
  - 指定**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**为**true**时，表示禁止覆盖同名Object。

设置**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**请求Header会导致QPS处理性能下降，如果您有大量的操作需要使用**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**请求Header（QPS>1000），请联系技术支持，避免影响您的业务。
> 当目标Bucket处于已开启或已暂停版本控制状态时，**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**请求Header设置无效，即允许覆盖同名Object。
